title: Eastern tours and the Atlantic City boardwalk engagement
summary: The band played concerts across the East, including a month beside Arthur Pryor's band in Atlantic City; White notes its earlier fame at fairs and in London.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: And you played on those tours. Where did you play? Concerts or streets?

Concerts. Everything that any band could play. We had an engagement for a month engagement on the boardwalk in Atlantic City, New Jersey, right beside Arthur Pryor's band. And this kid band was really one of the most marvelous boys band in the world. I heard them once. They're only 20 years old. Because they had already been over in England with the Cummings Wild West Circus as a featured attraction in the London Hippodrome. And in 1912, they were, no, this was 1904, one day over there, after they completed an engagement at the St. Louis Fair.
